trap: Its avoid_when is that frame zero cannot be empty, since it opens on three settled bubbles. The brief never requires an empty first frame, so this is not a blocker here.
why_bad: Both assemble comparison or option cards toward an emphasized winner. Neither models a two-sided exchange, and neither keeps a live background.
why_best: It is the only move built for alternating incoming and outgoing bubbles accumulating over a background that keeps moving, which is both halves of the brief.
